title: Empanada de Queso y Verduras
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Argentinian empanadas, filled with a mix of cheeses and sautéed vegetables.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough, about 4 inches in diameter.
Mix together the mozzarella and parmesan cheese.
Sauté the onion and bell pepper in a pan until softened.
Add the sautéed vegetables to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Brush the edges with water and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges to seal and use a fork to crimp.
Brush the tops with the citrusy caper sauce (if using).
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
